purpose: New V3 suffixes bound to immutable full prefixes; preserves exact row/operation order without rewriting parent data

parent_archive.format: DEGREE3_M3_FORMAT.json; extract into a separate parent directory and verify manifest.sha256

fields.meaning: first global row ID, equal to prefix rank
first global operation step, equal to prefix operation count

suffix.rows.u64le.record_encoding: 11489 little-endian u64 words; bit c represents squarefree monomial column c; no extra/trailing bytes
suffix.rows.u64le.column_order: Graded colex, identical to the parent: 0 constant; 1+i variable i; 1+n+C(j,2)+i for i<j; 1+n+C(n,2)+C(k,3)+C(j,2)+i for i<j<k; variable indices zero-based
suffix.rows.u64le.global_row_lookup: id<prefix_rows reads parent header28+id*record_bytes; otherwise suffix header44+(id-prefix_rows)*record_bytes

suffix.operations.jsonl: One JSON object per new processed source. step and inserted_row are global; source is equation ID or parent row ID plus zero-based variable; xor_basis_rows is the exact ordered list of global reducer IDs; inserted_row=null means zero remainder. Fresh replay recomputes the canonical operation.
continuation.json: SHA256 and byte length of each parent basis/operations/state/result file; prefix row/operation counts, pending count and next source; cumulative caps and exact system hash
closure_state.json: Cumulative rank and processed count, exact pending count/next source, complete flag and first stop reason: queue_exhausted, row_cap or operation_cap
result.json: Full native verdict and source identity; V2 binding; continuation binding; added_rows/added_operations; witness_origin distinguishes parent_prefix from new_suffix; unknown exact LFD and upper bounds remain null
progress.jsonl: Diagnostic cumulative and added counts, pending count and completion flag, flushed every128 new operations and at terminal state
summary.json: Native per-case results; only producer+fresh-replay success exposes certified numerical fields; includes failures and missing cases
status/: Per-case process exits and immutable cumulative summary snapshots
logs/: Producer stdout/stderr, including any timeouts or partial failures
controls/: Positive/negative fixtures, parent/suffix/uninterrupted byte-equivalence records; rejected tampering traces retained separately in development evidence
inputs/: Exact input.json and system.sing snapshots, unchanged from parent run
v2/: Original complete V2 rows, operations and verdict, replayed before every continuation
manifest.sha256: SHA256 map of every file in the sealed suffix run except the manifest itself; parent files have their own immutable manifest
claim_boundary: Complete V3 is not a global LFD upper certificate; capped traces prove admitted memberships only. No rank is labelled degree of regularity or solving degree. Parent witnesses remain parent witnesses.
restoration: Download/verify parent and suffix archives into separate fresh directories. Replay with instrument replay INPUTS ID V2_DIR PARENT/cases/KEY SUFFIX/cases/KEY. Verify both manifests after replay. This version accepts one full parent plus one suffix.
